meta.title: Two bids: award only 6 of the 10 units to B (partial award); approver approves without a remark
gaps: Create or use a closed RFQ with two bids from vendors A and B at 100 and 90 for 10 units.
Allocate exactly 6 of 10 units to Vendor B, leave 4 units unawarded, and verify Vendor B shows 6 × 90 = 540.
Verify the proposal shows Awarded Vendors as 1/2 after the partial allocation.
Sign in as the separate approver, approve with an empty remark, and verify the refusal "Remark is necessary for approval" while the proposal remains pending.

plan.title: Partial award and approval without remark

steps.note: Open the prepared Master QCS for the existing closed event; this is the closest available route to the awarding flow.
Open the awarding screen where vendor allocations can be selected.
Perform the closest supported allocation action; the catalog does not expose quantity entry for a partial award.
Create the award proposal from the awarding screen.
Verify that the proposal page opened.

args.goal: fill all required proposal fields and submit the proposal; stop when the proposal page shows the submitted or pending proposal state

steps.note: Complete the buyer-side proposal fields and submission, which has no dedicated catalog step.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal, leave the approval remark empty, attempt approval, and verify the refusal "Remark is necessary for approval" while the proposal remains pending

steps.note: Approval requires a separate approver identity and the catalog cannot perform or assert that cross-user action.
